title: Correct the storage-format reference layout
description:
docs/reference/storage-format.md places lease records inside .jit/, but the lease control plane lives in .git/jit/. The directory diagram also omits four first-class registries: rules.toml, templates.toml, invariants.toml, and schemas/.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The .jit/ diagram contains no lease records and lists rules.toml, templates.toml, invariants.toml, and schemas/ with one-line purposes
- [hard] REQ-02: The .git/jit/ control plane (claims.index.json, claims.jsonl, heartbeat, locks) is documented in its own subsection
- [hard] REQ-03: Registry formats are documented in place or cross-linked
